links.context: This set of Operating System Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Basics”.

mcqs.question: What is an operating system?

options.a: a) collection of programs that manages hardware resources
options.b: b) system service provider to the application programs
options.c: c) interface between the hardware and application programs

mcqs.explanation: An Operating System acts as an intermediary between user/user applications/application programs and hardware. It is a program that manages hardware resources. It provides services to application programs.

mcqs.question: To access the services of operating system, the interface is provided by the ___________
mcqs.explanation: To access services of the Operating System an interface is provided by the System Calls. Generally, these are functions written in C and C++. Open, Close, Read, Write are some of most prominently used system calls.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is not true?

options.a: a) kernel is the program that constitutes the central core of the operating system
options.b: b) kernel is the first part of operating system to load into memory during booting
options.c: c) kernel is made of various modules which can not be loaded in running operating system
options.d: d) kernel remains in the memory during the entire computer session

mcqs.answer: c) kernel is made of various modules which can not be loaded in running operating system
mcqs.explanation: Kernel is the first program which is loaded in memory when OS is loading as well as it remains in memory till OS is running. Kernel is the core part of the OS which is responsible for managing resources, allowing multiple processes to use the resources and provide services to various processes. Kernel modules can be loaded and unloaded in run-time i.e. in running OS.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following error will be handle by the operating system?

options.b: b) lack of paper in printer
options.c: c) connection failure in the network

mcqs.explanation: All the mentioned errors are handled by OS. The OS is continuously monitoring all of its resources. Also, the OS is constantly detecting and correcting errors.

mcqs.question: What is the main function of the command interpreter?

options.a: a) to get and execute the next user-specified command
options.b: b) to provide the interface between the API and application program
options.c: c) to handle the files in operating system

mcqs.answer: a) to get and execute the next user-specified command
mcqs.explanation: The main function of command interpreter is to get and execute the next user-specified command. Command Interpreter checks for valid command and then runs that command else it will throw an error.

mcqs.question: In Operating Systems, which of the following is/are CPU scheduling algorithms?
mcqs.explanation:
In Operating Systems, CPU scheduling algorithms are:
i) First Come First Served scheduling
ii) Shortest Job First scheduling
iii) Priority scheduling
iv) Round Robin scheduling
v) Multilevel Queue scheduling
vi) Multilevel Feedback Queue scheduling
All of these scheduling algorithms have their own advantages and disadvantages.

mcqs.question: If a process fails, most operating system write the error information to a ______
mcqs.explanation: If a process fails, most operating systems write the error information to a log file. Log file is examined by the debugger, to find out what is the actual cause of that particular problem. Log file is useful for system programmers for correcting errors.

mcqs.question: Which facility dynamically adds probes to a running system, both in user processes and in the kernel?
mcqs.explanation: A facility that dynamically adds probes to a running system, both in user process and in the kernel is called DTrace. This is very much useful in troubleshooting kernels in real-time.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is not a real time operating system?
mcqs.explanation: VxWorks, QNX & RTLinux are real-time operating systems. Palm OS is a mobile operating system. Palm OS is developed for Personal Digital Assistants (PDAs).

mcqs.question: The OS X has ____________
mcqs.explanation: OS X has a hybrid kernel. Hybrid kernel is a combination of two different kernels. OS X is developed by Apple and originally it is known as Mac OS X.

links.context: This set of Operating System Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Process Management”.

mcqs.question: The systems which allow only one process execution at a time, are called __________
mcqs.explanation: Those systems which allow more than one process execution at a time, are called multiprocessing systems. Uniprocessing means only one processor.

mcqs.question: In operating system, each process has its own __________

options.a: a) address space and global variables
options.c: c) pending alarms, signals and signal handlers

mcqs.explanation: In Operating Systems, each process has its own address space which contains code, data, stack and heap segments or sections. Each process also has a list of files which is opened by the process as well as all pending alarms, signals and various signal handlers.

mcqs.question: In Unix, Which system call creates the new process?
mcqs.explanation: In UNIX, a new process is created by fork() system call. fork() system call returns a process ID which is generally the process id of the child process created.

mcqs.question: A process can be terminated due to __________
mcqs.explanation: A process can be terminated normally by completing its task or because of fatal error or killed by another process or forcefully killed by a user. When the process completes its task without any error then it exits normally. The process may exit abnormally because of the occurrence of fatal error while it is running. The process can be killed or terminated forcefully by another process.

mcqs.question: What is the ready state of a process?

options.a: a) when process is scheduled to run after some execution
options.b: b) when process is unable to run until some task has been completed
options.c: c) when process is using the CPU

mcqs.answer: a) when process is scheduled to run after some execution
mcqs.explanation: Ready state of the process means process has all necessary resources which are required for execution of that process when CPU is allocated. Process is ready for execution but waiting for the CPU to be allocated.

mcqs.question: What is interprocess communication?

options.c: c) communication between two threads of same process

mcqs.explanation: Interprocess Communication (IPC) is a communication mechanism that allows processes to communicate with each other and synchronise their actions without using the same address space. IPC can be achieved using shared memory and message passing.

mcqs.question: A set of processes is deadlock if __________

options.a: a) each process is blocked and will remain so forever
options.c: c) all processes are trying to kill each other

mcqs.answer: a) each process is blocked and will remain so forever
mcqs.explanation: Deadlock is a situation which occurs because process A is waiting for one resource and holds another resource (blocking resource). At the same time another process B demands blocking a resource as it is already held by a process A, process B is waiting state unless and until process A releases occupied resource.

mcqs.question: A process stack does not contain __________
mcqs.explanation: Process stack contains Function parameters, Local variables and Return address. It does not contain the PID of child process.

mcqs.question: Which system call can be used by a parent process to determine the termination of child process?
mcqs.explanation: wait() system call is used by the parent process to determine termination of child process. The parent process uses wait() system call and gets the exit status of the child process as well as the pid of the child process which is terminated.

mcqs.question: The address of the next instruction to be executed by the current process is provided by the __________
mcqs.explanation: The address of the next instruction to be executed by the current process is provided by the Program Counter. After every instruction is executed, the Program Counter is incremented by 1 i.e. address of the next instruction to be executed. CPU fetches instruction from the address denoted by Program Counter and execute it.

links.context: This set of Operating System Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Process Control Block”.

mcqs.question: A Process Control Block(PCB) does not contain which of the following?
mcqs.explanation: Process Control Block (PCB) contains information related to a process such as Process State, Program Counter, CPU Register, etc. Process Control Block is also known as Task Control Block. Bootstrap program is a program which runs initially when the system or computer is booted or rebooted.

mcqs.question: The number of processes completed per unit time is known as __________
mcqs.explanation: The number of processes completed per unit time is known as Throughput. Suppose there are 4 processes A, B, C & D they are taking 1, 3, 4 & 7 units of time respectively for their executions. For 10 units of time, throughput is high if process A, B & C are running first as 3 processes can execute. If process C runs first then throughput is low as maximum only 2 processes can execute. Throughput is low for processes which take a long time for execution. Throughput is high for processes which take a short time for execution.

mcqs.question: The state of a process is defined by __________

options.a: a) the final activity of the process
options.b: b) the activity just executed by the process
options.c: c) the activity to next be executed by the process
options.d: d) the current activity of the process

mcqs.answer: d) the current activity of the process
mcqs.explanation: The state of a process is defined by the current activity of the process. A process state changes when the process executes. The process states are as New, Ready, Running, Wait, Terminated.

mcqs.question: Which of the following is not the state of a process?
mcqs.explanation: There is no process state such as old. When a process is created then the process is in New state. When the process gets the CPU for its execution then the process is in Running state. When the process is waiting for an external event then the process is in a Waiting state.

mcqs.question: What is a Process Control Block?
mcqs.explanation: A Process Control Block (PCB) is a data structure. It contains information related to a process such as Process State, Program Counter, CPU Register, etc. Process Control Block is also known as Task Control Block.

mcqs.question: The entry of all the PCBs of the current processes is in __________
mcqs.explanation: The entry of all the PCBs of the current processes is in Process Table. The Process Table has the status of each and every process that is created in OS along with their PIDs.

mcqs.question: What is the degree of multiprogramming?

options.a: a) the number of processes executed per unit time
options.b: b) the number of processes in the ready queue
options.c: c) the number of processes in the I/O queue
options.d: d) the number of processes in memory

mcqs.answer: d) the number of processes in memory
mcqs.explanation: Multiprogramming means the number of processes are in the ready states. To increase utilization of CPU, Multiprogramming is one of the most important abilities of OS. Generally, a single process cannot use CPU or I/O at all time, whenever CPU or I/O is available another process can use it. By doing this CPU utilization is increased.

mcqs.question: A single thread of control allows the process to perform __________

options.a: a) only one task at a time
options.b: b) multiple tasks at a time
options.c: c) only two tasks at a time

mcqs.answer: a) only one task at a time
mcqs.explanation: A single thread of control allows the process to perform only one task at a time. In the case of multi-core, multiple threads can be run simultaneously and can perform multiple tasks at a time.

mcqs.question: What is the objective of multiprogramming?

options.a: a) Have a process running at all time
options.b: b) Have multiple programs waiting in a queue ready to run

mcqs.explanation: The objective of multiprogramming is to increase CPU utilization. Generally, a single process cannot use CPU or I/O at all time, whenever CPU or I/O is available another process can use it. Multiprogramming offers this ability to OS by keeping multiple programs in a ready queue.

links.context: This set of Operating System Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Process Scheduling Queues”.

mcqs.question: Which of the following do not belong to queues for processes?
mcqs.explanation: PCB queue does not belong to queues for processes. PCB is a process control block which contains information related to process. Each process is represented by PCB.

mcqs.question: When the process issues an I/O request __________

options.a: a) It is placed in an I/O queue
options.b: b) It is placed in a waiting queue
options.c: c) It is placed in the ready queue
options.d: d) It is placed in the Job queue

mcqs.answer: a) It is placed in an I/O queue
mcqs.explanation: When the process issues an I/O request it is placed in an I/O queue. I/O is a resource and it should be used effectively and every process should get access to it. There might be multiple processes which requested for I/O. Depending on scheduling algorithm I/O is allocated to any particular process and after completing I/O operation, I/O access is returned to the OS.

mcqs.question: What will happen when a process terminates?

options.a: a) It is removed from all queues
options.b: b) It is removed from all, but the job queue
options.c: c) Its process control block is de-allocated
options.d: d) Its process control block is never de-allocated

mcqs.answer: a) It is removed from all queues
mcqs.explanation: When a process terminates, it removes from all queues. All allocated resources to that particular process are deallocated and all those resources are returned back to OS.

mcqs.question: What is a long-term scheduler?

options.a: a) It selects processes which have to be brought into the ready queue
options.b: b) It selects processes which have to be executed next and allocates CPU
options.c: c) It selects processes which heave to remove from memory by swapping

mcqs.answer: a) It selects processes which have to be brought into the ready queue
mcqs.explanation: A long-term scheduler selects processes which have to be brought into the ready queue. When processes enter the system, they are put in the job queue. Long-term scheduler selects processes from the job queue and puts them in the ready queue. It is also known as Job Scheduler.

mcqs.question: If all processes I/O bound, the ready queue will almost always be ______ and the Short term Scheduler will have a ______ to do.
mcqs.explanation: If all processes are I/O bound, the ready queue will almost empty and the short-term scheduler will have a little to do. I/O bound processes spend more time doing I/O than computation.

mcqs.question: What is a medium-term scheduler?

options.a: a) It selects which process has to be brought into the ready queue
options.b: b) It selects which process has to be executed next and allocates CPU
options.c: c) It selects which process to remove from memory by swapping

mcqs.answer: c) It selects which process to remove from memory by swapping
mcqs.explanation: A medium-term scheduler selects which process to remove from memory by swapping. The medium-term scheduler swapped out the process and later swapped in. Swapping helps to free up memory.

mcqs.question: What is a short-term scheduler?

options.a: a) It selects which process has to be brought into the ready queue
options.b: b) It selects which process has to be executed next and allocates CPU
options.c: c) It selects which process to remove from memory by swapping

mcqs.answer: b) It selects which process has to be executed next and allocates CPU
mcqs.explanation: A short-term scheduler selects a process which has to be executed next and allocates CPU. Short-term scheduler selects a process from the ready queue. It selects processes frequently.

mcqs.question: The primary distinction between the short term scheduler and the long term scheduler is __________

options.a: a) The length of their queues
options.b: b) The type of processes they schedule
options.c: c) The frequency of their execution

mcqs.answer: c) The frequency of their execution
mcqs.explanation: The primary distinction between the short-term scheduler and the long-term scheduler is the frequency of their execution. The short-term scheduler executes frequently while the long-term scheduler executes much less frequently.

mcqs.question: The only state transition that is initiated by the user process itself is __________
mcqs.explanation: The only state transition that is initiated by the user process itself is block. Whenever a user process initiates an I/O request it goes into block state unless and until the I/O request is not completed.

mcqs.question: In a time-sharing operating system, when the time slot given to a process is completed, the process goes from the running state to the __________
mcqs.explanation: In a time-sharing operating system, when the time slot given to a process is completed, the process goes from the running state to the Ready State. In a time-sharing operating system unit time is defined for sharing CPU, it is called a time quantum or time slice. If a process takes less than 1 time quantum, then the process itself releases the CPU.

mcqs.question: In a multiprogramming environment __________

options.a: a) the processor executes more than one process at a time
options.b: b) the programs are developed by more than one person
options.c: c) more than one process resides in the memory
options.d: d) a single user can execute many programs at the same time

mcqs.answer: c) more than one process resides in the memory
mcqs.explanation: In a multiprogramming environment more than one process resides in the memory. Whenever a CPU is available, one process amongst all present in memory gets the CPU for execution. Multiprogramming increases CPU utilization.

mcqs.question: Suppose that a process is in “Blocked” state waiting for some I/O service. When the service is completed, it goes to the __________
mcqs.explanation: Suppose that a process is in “Blocked” state waiting for some I/O service. When the service is completed, it goes to the ready state. Process never goes directly to the running state from the waiting state. Only processes which are in ready state go to the running state whenever CPU allocated by operating system.

mcqs.question: The context of a process in the PCB of a process does not contain __________

options.a: a) the value of the CPU registers

mcqs.explanation: The context of a process in the PCB of a process does not contain context switch time. When switching CPU from one process to another, the current context of the process needs to be saved. It includes values of the CPU registers, process states, memory-management information.

mcqs.question: Which of the following need not necessarily be saved on a context switch between processes?
mcqs.explanation: Translation Look-aside Buffer (TLB) need not necessarily be saved on a context switch between processes. A special, small, fast-lookup hardware cache is called Translation Look-aside Buffer. TLB used to reduce memory access time.

mcqs.question: Which of the following does not interrupt a running process?
mcqs.explanation: Scheduler process does not interrupt a running process. Scheduler process selects an available process from a pool of available processes and allocates CPU to it.

links.context: This set of Operating System Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Process Synchronization”.

mcqs.question: Which process can be affected by other processes executing in the system?
mcqs.explanation: A cooperating process can be affected by other processes executing in the system. Also it can affect other processes executing in the system. A process shares data with other processes, such a process is known as a cooperating process.

mcqs.question: When several processes access the same data concurrently and the outcome of the execution depends on the particular order in which the access takes place is called ________
mcqs.explanation: When several processes access the same data concurrently and the outcome of the execution depends on the particular order in which access takes place is called race condition.

mcqs.question: If a process is executing in its critical section, then no other processes can be executing in their critical section. What is this condition called?
mcqs.explanation: If a process is executing in its critical section, then no other processes can be executed in their critical section. This condition is called Mutual Exclusion. Critical section of the process is shared between multiple processes. If this section is executed by more than one or all of them concurrently then the outcome of this is not as per desired outcome. For this reason the critical section of the process should not be executed concurrently.

mcqs.question: Which one of the following is a synchronization tool?
mcqs.explanation: Semaphore is a synchronization tool. Semaphore is a mechanism which synchronizes or controls access of threads on critical resources. There are two types of semaphores i) Binary Semaphore ii) Counting Semaphore.

mcqs.question: A semaphore is a shared integer variable __________

options.a: a) that can not drop below zero
options.b: b) that can not be more than zero
options.c: c) that can not drop below one
options.d: d) that can not be more than one

mcqs.answer: a) that can not drop below zero
mcqs.explanation: A semaphore is a shared integer variable that can not drop below zero. In binary semaphore, if the value of the semaphore variable is zero that means there is a process that uses a critical resource and no other process can access the same critical resource until it is released. In Counting semaphore, if the value of the semaphore variable is zero that means there is no resource available.

mcqs.question: Mutual exclusion can be provided by the __________

options.c: c) both mutex locks and binary semaphores

mcqs.answer: c) both mutex locks and binary semaphores
mcqs.explanation: Mutual exclusion can be provided by both mutex locks and binary semaphore. Mutex is a short form of Mutual Exclusion. Binary semaphore also provides a mechanism for mutual exclusion. Binary semaphore behaves similar to mutex locks.

mcqs.question: When high priority task is indirectly preempted by medium priority task effectively inverting the relative priority of the two tasks, the scenario is called __________
mcqs.explanation: When a high priority task is indirectly preempted by a medium priority task effectively inverting the relative priority of the two tasks, the scenario is called priority inversion.

mcqs.question: Process synchronization can be done on __________

options.c: c) both hardware and software level

mcqs.answer: c) both hardware and software level
mcqs.explanation: Process synchronization can be done on both hardware and software level. Critical section problems can be resolved using hardware synchronisation. But this method is not simple for implementation so software synchronization is mostly used.

mcqs.question: A monitor is a module that encapsulates __________

options.b: b) procedures that operate on shared data structure
options.c: c) synchronization between concurrent procedure invocation

mcqs.explanation: A monitor is a module that encapsulates shared data structures, procedures that operate on shared data structure, synchronization between concurrent procedure invocation.

mcqs.question: To enable a process to wait within the monitor __________

options.a: a) a condition variable must be declared as condition
options.b: b) condition variables must be used as boolean objects

mcqs.answer: a) a condition variable must be declared as condition
mcqs.explanation: To enable a process to wait within the monitor a condition variable must be declared as condition.

links.context: This set of Operating System Questions and Answers focuses on “Process Creation” and will also be useful for interview preparations.

mcqs.question: Restricting the child process to a subset of the parent’s resources prevents any process from __________

options.a: a) overloading the system by using a lot of secondary storage
options.b: b) under-loading the system by very less CPU utilization
options.c: c) overloading the system by creating a lot of sub-processes
options.d: d) crashing the system by utilizing multiple resources

mcqs.answer: c) overloading the system by creating a lot of sub-processes
mcqs.explanation: Restricting the child process to a subset of the parent’s resources prevents any process from overloading the system by creating a lot of sub-processes. A process creates a child process, child process requires certain resources to complete its task. A child process can demand required resources directly from the system, but by doing this system will be overloaded. So to avoid overloading of the system, the parent process shares its resources among children.

mcqs.question: A parent process calling _____ system call will be suspended until children processes terminate.
mcqs.explanation: A parent process calling wait system call will be suspended until children processes terminate. A parameter is passed to wait system call which will obtain exit status of child as well as wait system call returns PID of terminated process.

mcqs.question: Cascading termination refers to termination of all child processes if the parent process terminates ______
mcqs.explanation: Cascading termination refers to termination of all child processes if the parent process terminates Normally or Abnormally. Some systems don’t allow child processes to exist if the parent process has terminated. Cascading termination is normally initiated by the operating system.

mcqs.question: With _____________ only one process can execute at a time; meanwhile all other process are waiting for the processor. With ______________ more than one process can be running simultaneously each on a different processor.
mcqs.explanation: With Uniprogramming only one process can execute at a time; meanwhile all other processes are waiting for the processor. With Multiprocessing more than one process can run simultaneously each on different processors. The Uniprogramming system has only one program inside the core while the Multiprocessing system has multiple processes inside multiple cores. The core is one which executes instructions and stores data locally into registers.

mcqs.question: In UNIX, each process is identified by its __________
mcqs.explanation: In Unix, each process is identified by its Process Identifier or PID. The PID provides unique value to each process in the system so that each process can be identified uniquely.

mcqs.question: In UNIX, the return value for the fork system call is _____ for the child process and _____ for the parent process.
mcqs.explanation: In Unix, the return value of the fork system call is Zero for the child process and Non-zero value for parent process. A fork system call returns the PID of a newly created (child) process to the parent and returns Zero to that newly created (child) process.

mcqs.question: The child process can __________

options.a: a) be a duplicate of the parent process
options.b: b) never be a duplicate of the parent process
options.c: c) cannot have another program loaded into it
options.d: d) never have another program loaded into it

mcqs.answer: a) be a duplicate of the parent process
mcqs.explanation: The child process can be a duplicate of the parent process. The child process created by fork consists of a copy of the address space of the parent process.

mcqs.question: The child process completes execution, but the parent keeps executing, then the child process is known as __________
mcqs.explanation: The child process completes execution, but the parent keeps executing, then the child process is known as Zombie. When a child process terminates, its resources get deallocated but its entry in the Process Control Block (PCB) remains there until its parent calls wait system call.

links.context: This set of Operating System Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Inter Process Communication”.

mcqs.question: What is Interprocess communication?

options.a: a) allows processes to communicate and synchronize their actions when using the same address space
options.b: b) allows processes to communicate and synchronize their actions
options.c: c) allows the processes to only synchronize their actions without communication

mcqs.answer: b) allows processes to communicate and synchronize their actions
mcqs.explanation:
Interprocess Communication allows processes to communicate and synchronize their actions. Interprocess Communication (IPC) mechanism is used by cooperating processes to exchange data and information.
There are two models of IPC:
→ Shared Memory
→ Message Passing

mcqs.question: Message passing system allows processes to __________

options.a: a) communicate with each other without sharing the same address space
options.b: b) communicate with one another by resorting to shared data
options.d: d) name the recipient or sender of the message

mcqs.answer: a) communicate with each other without sharing the same address space
mcqs.explanation: Message Passing system allows processes to communicate with each other without sharing the same address space.

mcqs.question: Which of the following two operations are provided by the IPC facility?
mcqs.explanation: Two operations provided by the IPC facility are receive and send messages. Exchange of data takes place in cooperating processes.

mcqs.question: Messages sent by a process __________

options.a: a) have to be of a fixed size
options.b: b) have to be a variable size
options.c: c) can be fixed or variable sized

mcqs.answer: c) can be fixed or variable sized
mcqs.explanation: Messages sent by a process can be fixed or variable size. If the message size of the process is fixed then system level implementation is straightforward but it makes the task of programming more difficult. If the message size of the process is variable then system level implementation is more complex but it makes the task of programming simpler.

mcqs.question: The link between two processes P and Q to send and receive messages is called __________
mcqs.explanation: The link between two processes P and Q to send and receive messages is called communication link. Two processes P and Q want to communicate with each other; there should be a communication link that must exist between these two processes so that both processes can able to send and receive messages using that link.

mcqs.question: Which of the following are TRUE for direct communication?

options.a: a) A communication link can be associated with N number of process(N = max. number of processes supported by system)
options.b: b) A communication link is associated with exactly two processes
options.c: c) Exactly N/2 links exist between each pair of processes(N = max. number of processes supported by system)
options.d: d) Exactly two link exists between each pair of processes

mcqs.answer: b) A communication link is associated with exactly two processes
mcqs.explanation: For direct communication, a communication link is associated with exactly two processes. One communication link must exist between a pair of processes.

mcqs.question: In indirect communication between processes P and Q __________

options.a: a) there is another process R to handle and pass on the messages between P and Q
options.b: b) there is another machine between the two processes to help communication
options.c: c) there is a mailbox to help communication between P and Q

mcqs.answer: c) there is a mailbox to help communication between P and Q
mcqs.explanation: In indirect communication between processes P and Q there is a mailbox to help communication between P and Q. A mailbox can be viewed abstractly as an object into which messages can be placed by processes and from which messages can be removed.

mcqs.question: In the non blocking send __________

options.a: a) the sending process keeps sending until the message is received
options.b: b) the sending process sends the message and resumes operation
options.c: c) the sending process keeps sending until it receives a message

mcqs.answer: b) the sending process sends the message and resumes operation
mcqs.explanation: In the non blocking send, the sending process sends the message and resumes operation. Sending process doesn’t care about reception. It is also known as asynchronous send.

mcqs.question: In the Zero capacity queue __________

options.a: a) the queue can store at least one message
options.b: b) the sender blocks until the receiver receives the message
options.c: c) the sender keeps sending and the messages don’t wait in the queue

mcqs.answer: b) the sender blocks until the receiver receives the message
mcqs.explanation: In the Zero capacity queue the sender blocks until the receiver receives the message. Zero capacity queue has maximum capacity of Zero; thus message queue does not have any waiting message in it.

mcqs.question: The Zero Capacity queue __________

options.a: a) is referred to as a message system with buffering
options.b: b) is referred to as a message system with no buffering
options.c: c) is referred to as a link

mcqs.answer: b) is referred to as a message system with no buffering
mcqs.explanation: The Zero capacity queue is referred to as a message system with no buffering. Zero capacity queue has maximum capacity of Zero; thus message queue does not have any waiting message in it.

mcqs.question: Bounded capacity and Unbounded capacity queues are referred to as __________
mcqs.explanation: Bounded capacity and Unbounded capacity queues are referred to as Automatic buffering. Buffer capacity of the Bounded capacity queue is finite length and buffer capacity of the Unbounded queue is infinite.

links.context: This set of Operating System Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on “Remote Procedure Calls”.

mcqs.question: Remote Procedure Calls are used ____________

options.a: a) for communication between two processes remotely different from each other on the same system
